'''Chapter 1120''' is titled "Atlas". 

==Cover Page==
[[Oni Child Yamato's Golden Harvest Surrogate Pilgrimage]], Vol. 10: "[[Denjiro]], Daimyo of Kibi, sentences the children!"

==Short Summary==
In the past, it is revealed by [[Clou D. Clover|Clover]] to [[Vegapunk|Dr. Vegapunk]] that he is a [[Will of D.|D]]. and while Vegapunk initially refused to learn about the [[Void Century]], he later decided to do so after he learned of Clover's death and [[Nico Robin|Robin]]'s survival in order to honor his friendship with Clover and Ohara's memory. In the present, as Vegapunk's message continues, [[Vegapunk/Atlas|Atlas]] knocks out [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] and sacrifices herself so the [[Thousand Sunny]] can escape from [[Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro|Nusjuro]]. Meanwhile, the [[Emet|Iron Giant]] conveys a message to [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], as the other [[Five Elders|Elders]] decide to completely destroy it. Vegapunk then prepares to end his message as he states the twenty-five years ago, the [[Roger Pirates]] learned the true history.

==Long Summary==
Twenty-six years ago on [[Punk Hazard]], [[Clou D. Clover|Clover]] met with [[Vegapunk|Dr. Vegapunk]] asking him to help study the [[Void Century]] alongside him and his colleagues. Dr. Vegapunk refused as he works for the [[World Government]] now. He also reminds Clover how many times he has been arrested by them and that the only reason he has lived for so long is so that the World Government can follow him to his colleagues and eliminate them all. Clover, however, reveals to Dr. Vegapunk that his older brother had the secret name "[[Will of D.|D.]]", and he was killed for it, with Clover, whose full name is Clou D. Clover, only able to survive by lying about his association. Because of that, Clover cannot accept a world where people die just because of their name, which is why he is so dedicated to unearthing the truth of the world. Despite hearing that, Dr. Vegapunk once again says he cannot help but promises to keep what Clover told him a secret, while also wishing him the best of luck. Clover declares he'll solve the mystery of the [[world]] someday.

Four years later, Dr. Vegapunk is informed of the [[Buster Call]] that occurred on [[Ohara]], which [[Caesar Clown]] was thrilled to hear, believing it will serve as a warning to anyone who dares to study the Void Century. Dr. Vegapunk later visited the ruined island, and with tears in his eyes, asks Clover why he did not escape like he always did this time and why he thought saving his research was more important.

In the present, Dr. Vegapunk's message continues as he quotes Clover's words about how the voices of the past will be heard. He also says that history is written by the winners while the losers disappear without a trace, but the echoes of those voices were finally able to be reached to the rest of the world despite the sacrifices made.

Back at the [[Thousand Sunny]], [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] tells everyone to take off, but [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] says they cannot with [[Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro|Nusjuro]] on their tail because if he interferes with the ship's takeoff, even by a little bit, the ship will not make it to sea. Suddenly, [[Vegapunk/Atlas|Atlas]] flies up to her and knocks her out before cutting off her connection to [[Punk Records]] which makes [[Vegapunk/York|York]] think she is dead. Atlas asks the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] to take care of Lilith while she goes to stop Nusjuro. Immediately, she flies straight for him and grabs him, losing her left arm in the process, before flying him away as the ship finally uses Coup de Burst, taking off in the sky.

Down on the ground, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] is stoked to see [[Emet]] moving, while Emet expresses happiness in seeing "[[Joy Boy]]" again, even though he gets annoyed when Luffy gets confused regarding who he is talking about. Emet tells Luffy to go on while he holds off the [[Five Elders]], with [[Topman Warcury|Warcury]] and [[Shepherd Ju Peter|Peter]] realizing they cannot stop Dr. Vegapunk's message without completely destroying the robot. The [[Giants]] ask Luffy if Emet is on their side and he tells them he told him yes. To his surprise, no one else heard Emet speak and only Luffy heard him speak. Peter makes his move and charges for Emet who sticks out his arm preparing to fire something. Unfortunately, it fails to fire and Peter chomps down on his arm while [[Jaygarcia Saturn|Saturn]] jumps off his back onto the Giants' ship much to everyone's shock. [[Sanji]] then notices the Thousand Sunny flying through the air and heading downwards as Nusjuro asks Atlas if she would seriously sacrifice herself, but she simply says she is performing a service. Atlas then explodes as the crew watched in sorrow, while York jumps for joy over being the only Dr. Vegapunk left. Meanwhile, Emet remarks how rusty he has become over the centuries and decides to use what Joy Boy told him to save for the right moment.

All the while, Dr. Vegapunk says he has run out of time to continue studying the past. [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]], who he says his full name (to the confusion of others), along with his [[Roger Pirates]] crew members were able to hear the "purest" voices of the past.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*Professor Clover's real name is revealed to be [[Clou D. Clover]], making him and his deceased brother carriers of the initial [[Will of D.|D.]]
*[[Vegapunk/Atlas|Atlas]] decides to sacrifice herself so that the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] can escape safely from [[Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro|Nusjuro]].
**[[Vegapunk/Atlas|Atlas]] knocks out [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] unconscious, to prevent [[Vegapunk/York|York]] from locating her.
**York therefore assumes she is the sole [[Vegapunk]], unaware that Lilith is still alive.
*[[Emet]] can communicate to [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] via the [[Voice of All Things]].
**Emet refers to Luffy as [[Joy Boy]], who is still unaware of Joy Boy's true identity.
*[[Shepherd Ju Peter|Peter]] and [[Jaygarcia Saturn|Saturn]] fight Emet.
**Peter bites off Emet's left arm.
**[[Jaygarcia Saturn|Saturn]] uses the opportunity to jump onto the [[Giant Warrior Pirates]]' ship.
*[[Vegapunk]] reveals Roger's real name, [[Gol D. Roger]], to the rest of the world.
